state.product: MenteViva, an iOS brain-training app for healthy-to-mild older adults 60+ (preventive focus), purchased by adult children. Offline-first, EN/ES bilingual, warm tone, huge touch targets, no timers pressuring the player, no fail shame, no clinical scores.
current_games: Memory Lane: emoji pair matching (episodic/working memory)
Color Clash: Stroop, tap the ink color (executive inhibition)
Name the Herd: name N animals in a category (verbal fluency)
Number Trail: simple adaptive math streaks (numeracy + processing)

evidence_by_domain.processing_speed: Strongest evidence: ACTIVE trial (N=2,802, 10-yr follow-up) speed-of-processing arm cut dementia incidence 29%, dose-dependent; broad transfer to daily function. UFOV implementation is licensed; generic speed tasks are buildable.
evidence_by_domain.working_memory: Near transfer reliable, far transfer unproven (23-study meta-analysis).
evidence_by_domain.episodic_memory: Trains reliably in healthy older adults; strategy training persists but rarely transfers beyond memory tasks.
evidence_by_domain.executive_inhibition: Improves on trained tasks; far transfer inconsistent.
evidence_by_domain.verbal_fluency: Least studied as a training target; more a language/social exercise.
evidence_by_domain.numeracy: Not a distinct evidence domain in the CCT literature; math streaks here mix simple processing speed with engagement.

state.constraints: Solo developer; v1 ships 4 games; small and polished beats broad and shallow. v1 currently covers working/episodic memory, inhibition, fluency, and numeracy; processing speed is NOT yet covered as a dedicated game.
